turns.question: what is java compiler?
turns.answer: The Java compiler is the javac tool that translates Java source code into Java bytecode, which is an intermediate representation that the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) executes; it is not intended for normal programming use and has been deprecated by JDK 9 [1].
